title: Independently audit GL3 support pruning against both encoders
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Audit the specific support-pruning implication left for independent review in PR4211: every attaining word in the stated group-algebra model has cut support inside `B_t intersect (B_(n-t)*T_c)`, with the target on the right. The original argument belongs to the predecessor; this adds an implementation-independent check and exact caller binding, not new pruning or a minimum-nine recertification.

The independent oracle covers all168group elements, six CNOT labels,28legal projectors,168factor involutions and84672regular-module basis checks. It retains153 complete length7/8 cone rows. An actual legal noncommuting two-call word detects the wrong translate; dirty-restoring/mixed-register examples and the direct-nine word are positive controls.

The source-reusing adapter compares both actual masks and all117CNF interior allocation rows/5247state bits. It regenerates both saved CNFs byte-exactly (61138/97770clauses), and checks four semantic mutants. It does not solve or replay RUP proofs. Full Tseitin/endpoint equivalence, free-mixing normalization, lower-bound admission, physical supplier and human/formal-kernel acceptance remain open. No kappa/frontier change.

[Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2102#discussioncomment-19078406). Fresh327open/draft bodies, board/hub/source thread checked; broader coverage partial, not novelty evidence. James Reed's prior finite pin/seal audit explicitly excludes encoding equivalence.

## Validation

Python3.12 stdlib, four registered normal/optimized commands: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl3-support-cone-audit`. Warm and exact committed Git-free replay pass; all28package files remain unchanged. Current27file seals, source history and current alias bindings pass; exact-public-head cold/hosted receipts are recorded in the final Discussion handoff. Immutable sourceCRLF is retained by the scoped package attributes. Initial typed receipt lengths were corrected during separate prepublication review, with old history preserved and mathematical data unchanged.

## Open next questions

Select one remaining clause/normalization implication for a separate exact audit, then independently replay the saved RUP proofs under a separately assessed resource budget. These links are needed before the full encoded lower bound is independently admitted. No merge requested; maintainer edits disabled.
